name: Dropradar · Cine 3D
description: Animación 3D cinematográfica de película familiar, expresiva y coherente con el anuncio de referencia.

visual.lighting: Soft motivated lighting, coherent shadows, integrated characters and environment, warm skin tones and controlled highlights.
visual.camera: A single coherent shot per generation, natural camera motion, consistent scale and perspective. Use motivated editing between shots.
visual.negative_prompt: green-screen edges, pasted subject, background replacement, detached limbs, extra fingers, duplicated people, deformed face, drifting identity, floating laptop, reversed screen, unreadable generated typography, logos over the scene, brand end card, abrupt unmotivated camera jump
